{
  "action": "shell",
  "command": "cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c "
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache
from cachetools import Cache, LRUCache

# Test resize with growing
c = TaggedCache(2)
c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
c.resize(5)
assert len(c) == 2
assert c.get('a') == 1
assert c.get('b') == 2
print('Grow resize OK')

# Test resize invalid raises ValueError before mutation
c2 = TaggedCache(3)
c2.put('a', 1, ['x'])
try:
    c2.resize(0)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
assert len(c2) == 1
print('Invalid resize OK')

# Test invalid maxsize in constructor
try:
    TaggedCache(-1)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
print('Invalid constructor OK')

# Test invalid bool maxsize
try:
    TaggedCache(True)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
print('Bool maxsize rejected OK')

# Test invalid bool maxsize in resize
try:
    TaggedCache(5).resize(True)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
print('Bool resize rejected OK')

print('All edge case checks passed!')
""}
